# ClubSync

> ClubSync is the home for a student's extracurricular life — clubs, events, and verified service hours in one place.

ClubSync is a school-focused platform where students discover and join clubs, register for club events, and track verified community-service hours. Club directors manage rosters, events, attendance, and announcements; school administrators oversee clubs and users across the platform.

Almost all content in ClubSync is private to a signed-in student, club director, or school administrator — there is no public content to summarize beyond the marketing pages linked below.
